items.p: Introduce yourself. Say your name, age, where you are from, what you do and one hobby.
items.pv: Giới thiệu bản thân: tên, tuổi, quê, bạn làm gì.
u: In my free time, I like
items.m: Hello! My name is Minh and I'm twenty years old. I'm from Da Nang, but now I live in Hanoi. I'm a student at a university of technology. In my free time, I like playing badminton and listening to music.

items.p: Describe your home. Where is it? How many rooms are there? What is your favourite room?
items.pv: Tả nhà bạn: ở đâu, có mấy phòng, phòng bạn thích nhất.
c: Phòng yêu thích và lý do
items.m: I live in a small house near the market. There are three bedrooms, a kitchen and a living room. My favourite room is the kitchen, because it is warm and my mother cooks delicious food there.

items.p: Talk about your favourite food. What is it? When do you eat it? Who cooks it?
items.pv: Nói về món ăn bạn thích: món gì, khi nào ăn, ai nấu.
c: Ai nấu hoặc bạn mua ở đâu
items.m: My favourite food is pho. I usually eat it for breakfast on Sunday. My father often makes it at home, but sometimes we go to a small restaurant near my school. It is hot and very tasty.

items.p: Talk about your best friend. What is his or her name? How old is he or she? What does he or she look like? What do you do together?
items.pv: Nói về bạn thân: tên, ngoại hình, hai bạn làm gì cùng nhau.
c: Việc hai bạn làm cùng nhau
items.m: My best friend is Hoa. She is nineteen. She is tall and she has long black hair. She is very funny. We often go to the cinema together, and at weekends we ride our bikes around the lake.

items.p: What is the weather like today? What do you like to do in this weather? What is your favourite season?
items.pv: Hôm nay thời tiết thế nào? Bạn thích làm gì khi thời tiết như vậy?
items.m: Today it is cloudy and a little cold. When it is like this, I like to stay at home and read a book with a cup of tea. When it is sunny, I go to the park. My favourite season is autumn.

items.p: Tell me about a holiday you enjoyed. Where did you go? Who did you go with? What did you do there?
items.pv: Kể về một kỳ nghỉ bạn thích: đi đâu, với ai, làm gì.
c: Đi cùng ai, đi bằng gì
items.m: Last summer I went to Phu Quoc with my family. We went there by plane, and it only took one hour. We stayed in a small hotel near the beach. Every day we swam, ate seafood and walked on the beach in the evening. The best part was a boat trip to a small island. I really enjoyed it because the water was so clear and blue.

items.p: Describe a typical day in your life. What do you do in the morning, afternoon and evening? Which part of the day do you like best?
items.pv: Tả một ngày điển hình của bạn và phần nào trong ngày bạn thích nhất.
c: Phần bạn thích nhất và lý do
items.m: I usually get up at half past six and have breakfast with my sister. Then I go to work by motorbike. I work in an office from eight to five. After that, I go to the gym or meet friends. In the evening I cook dinner and watch a series. I like the evening best because I can relax and do what I want.

items.p: Do you like shopping? Where do you usually shop, and what do you buy? Do you prefer shopping online or in shops?
items.pv: Bạn có thích mua sắm không? Thường mua ở đâu, mua gì? Bạn thích mua online hay ở cửa hàng?
c: Bạn có thích mua sắm không
Nơi mua và thứ hay mua
Online hay cửa hàng, vì sao
items.m: I don't really like shopping, but I sometimes go to the shopping centre with my friends. I usually buy clothes and books. I prefer shopping online to shopping in shops, because it is cheaper and faster. The problem is that sometimes the clothes are the wrong size, so I have to send them back.

items.p: Describe a person in your family you admire. What is he or she like? Why do you admire them?
items.pv: Tả một người trong gia đình bạn ngưỡng mộ: tính cách thế nào, vì sao bạn ngưỡng mộ.
c: Tính cách và việc họ làm
items.m: I really admire my grandmother. She is seventy-five, but she is very active. She gets up at five every morning and does exercise in the park. She is also very kind. For example, she cooks lunch for our neighbours when they are ill. I admire her because she always thinks about other people.

items.p: What are your plans for next weekend? Who will you spend time with? What are you looking forward to?
items.pv: Kế hoạch cuối tuần tới của bạn là gì? Bạn đi với ai? Bạn mong chờ điều gì?
items.m: Next weekend I'm going to visit my cousins in the countryside. On Saturday morning we're going to help my uncle in his garden, and in the afternoon we're going to fish in the river. On Sunday I'm meeting my friends for lunch in the city. I'm looking forward to the fishing trip, because I haven't done it for years.

items.p: Talk about your best friend. What is their name? How old are they? What do you do together?
items.pv: Nói về bạn thân nhất: tên, tuổi, hai bạn thường làm gì cùng nhau.
c: Bạn ấy làm nghề gì/học ở đâu
Hai bạn làm gì cùng nhau
Vì sao bạn thích bạn ấy
u: Bạn thân nhất của tôi là
items.m: My best friend is Hoa. She is twenty-one and she is a student at a university in Hanoi. We often go to the cinema together, and on Sundays we drink coffee by the lake. I like her because she is funny and kind.

items.p: Talk about your town or city. Is it big or small? What is there? What do you like about it?
items.pv: Nói về thị trấn hoặc thành phố của bạn: lớn hay nhỏ, có gì, bạn thích gì ở đó.
items.m: I live in Vinh. It is a city in the north of Vietnam. It is not very big. There is a big park and there are many good restaurants. I like the park because I can walk there in the evening.

items.p: Talk about what you usually do at the weekend. What do you do on Saturday and on Sunday? Who with? How do you feel at the weekend?
items.pv: Nói về việc bạn thường làm cuối tuần: thứ Bảy và Chủ nhật.
items.m: On Saturday I usually get up late. In the afternoon I play football with my friends. On Sunday I visit my grandparents and we have lunch together. In the evening I watch TV. I love weekends because I can relax.

items.en: Describe a Photo: A Busy Market
items.vi: Tả tranh: Khu chợ đông đúc
items.p: Imagine a photo of a busy market. Describe what you can see: the people, what they are doing, the things for sale and the weather.
items.pv: Hãy hình dung một bức ảnh chợ đông người. Tả những gì bạn thấy: người, họ đang làm gì, hàng hoá, thời tiết.
c: Mở đầu: bức ảnh về gì
Người trong ảnh đang làm gì (hiện tại tiếp diễn)
Vị trí (in the middle, on the left…)
Một câu đoán hoặc cảm nhận
u: In this photo, I can see
items.m: In this photo, I can see a busy market. In the middle, there is a woman who is selling fruit: mangoes, bananas and watermelons. On the left, two men are carrying big bags of rice. A girl is buying vegetables and she is talking to the seller. It looks like a hot day because people are wearing hats. I think it is early in the morning.

items.vi: Một lễ hội ở Việt Nam
items.p: Talk about a festival in Vietnam, for example the Mid-Autumn Festival. When is it? What do people do? What do you like about it?
items.pv: Nói về một lễ hội ở Việt Nam, ví dụ Tết Trung thu: khi nào, mọi người làm gì, bạn thích gì.
c: Tên lễ hội và thời gian
Kỷ niệm hoặc cảm nhận của bạn
items.m: I want to talk about the Mid-Autumn Festival. It is in September or October, when the moon is full. Children carry colourful lanterns and walk around the streets. People eat moon cakes and drink tea. When I was a child, my father made a star lantern for me. My favourite part is the lion dance, because it is loud and exciting.

items.p: Talk about your plans for next year. What are you going to do? Why? What do you hope will happen?
items.pv: Nói về kế hoạch năm tới: bạn sẽ làm gì, vì sao, bạn hy vọng điều gì.
c: Hai đến ba kế hoạch (be going to)
Một điều bạn hy vọng (I hope)
items.m: Next year I'm going to finish my course and look for a job in a hotel. I'm also going to study English every evening, because I want to talk to tourists. I hope I can save some money and travel to Thailand with my friends. It might be difficult to do everything, but I will try.

Come in for a hot breakfast or a delicious lunch.
Our menu has rice, noodles, chicken and many fresh vegetables.
Children's meals are only 30,000 dong.
You can order at the table or take your food home.

Try our big chicken soup!
Our kitchen is clean, and our cooks are friendly.
Please come early, because the bus doesn't wait for late students.
Students who are late must go to school with their parents.
There is no bus at the weekend.
Welcome to Da Nang Train Station.
Free city maps are at the information desk.
Take bus number 12 from the front of the station.
It leaves every twenty minutes.
Please keep your luggage with you.
For hotel booking, ask at desk 3.
It is free for all families.
Bring your parents, grandparents, brothers, sisters and cousins.
There is also a cooking game for mums and dads.
You can meet new friends and take family photos.
Food and drinks are cheap.

It has three bedrooms and two bathrooms.
The kitchen has a big table and eight chairs.
Behind the house there is a garden with fruit trees.
Call Mr Nam on 0905 123 456.
Wash your hands before you eat.
Don't touch your eyes or your face with dirty hands.
Sleep eight hours every night, and rest when you are tired.
If you are ill, stay at home.
Do you have a headache, or does your stomach hurt?
Come and see me in Room 5.
Do not take medicine without a doctor or your parents.
Keep your head warm when it is cold outside.
Cheap prices at Mai Clothes Shop on Le Loi Street!
This week all shirts are only 100,000 dong.
Children's shoes are half price.
Do you need a dress for a party?
Come and see our new dresses.
In the hot summer, wear one of our beautiful hats!
You can put on any clothes before you buy them.
It is good weather for the beach.
It is winter weather in the mountains, so wear warm clothes.
Do you want to learn English with friends?
It is free for all students.
Mr Ben, a teacher from London, helps us.
We play games, sing songs, and ask and answer questions.
It is not a lesson, and there is no exam!
You don't need to study before you come.
Summer fun at Ba Dinh Children's House!
Join our free classes from June to August.
We watch a film for children.
Find a new hobby this summer!
Classes are for children from seven to fourteen.
Story time for children is every Wednesday and Sunday morning.
Tomorrow it opens at the same time as every day.
The new school year starts again in autumn.
See old photos of streets, markets and families.
In August, during the summer holiday, children go in free.

We have all sizes for men, women and children.
You can pay by cash or card.
People on foot can still cross the street at the bridge.
We are sorry for any problems on your journey.
Can you give Milo a home?
He is never angry, and he doesn't bite.
Milo is a bit lazy and loves sleeping in the sun.
Visitors are welcome every day from nine to five.
Please be polite and quiet near the animals.
Free Computer Class at Ba Dinh Library!
Come and learn with us!
Bring your own laptop if you have one.
Classes are on Tuesday mornings from nine to eleven.
Come and celebrate the Lantern Festival in Hoi An!
Shops and houses are decorated with hundreds of colourful lanterns.
You can also buy lanterns as a gift for your friends.
The festival starts at six in the evening.
Body Science Day at the Hanoi Science Museum, Saturday 9 November!
Come and learn how your body works.
Tickets are 50,000 dong for adults and free for children.
Free Health Day at Thanh Xuan Clinic this Saturday!
A dentist will look at children's teeth.
Do you want to stop smoking?
Come and talk to us about your last cigarette!
Please bring a list of any drugs you take every day.
Try the new Haunted Forest ride at Green Hill Park!
Are you brave or are you scared of the dark?
It costs 80,000 dong, an excellent price!
Sunny Kids Club in Hue is looking for a summer helper.
Are you careful, serious about your work and good with children?
You should be independent and able to plan games alone.
A typical day starts at eight and finishes at four.
We pay a normal summer wage.
If you are interested, send us an email before 15 May.

Flat for rent near My Khe Beach, Da Nang.
This bright one-bedroom flat comes with all the furniture you need.
Please take your rubbish to the bin downstairs.
The price is 6 million dong a month.
Call Mr Hai to visit.
Be careful when you use a knife.
Never leave water to boil without watching it.
Do not take other students' biscuits or snacks!
The kitchen closes at ten at night.
You will make two dishes and one sweet dessert with nuts.
The kitchen will smell wonderful!
Classes are every Saturday at nine in the morning.
The price is 400,000 dong, with lunch included.
Our students made all the clothes themselves.

Tickets are free, but please arrive early.

It will arrive on Tuesday night.
Please do not go fishing or swimming.
Stay at home and keep your phone charged.
The sky will be clear again by Thursday.
Visit Ba Be National Park in the north of Vietnam!
There are rice fields and small villages in the valley.
Children love climbing on the big rocks near the river.
